title: Dutch Government Plans 25,000 Civil Servant Job Cuts in AI Drive
summary:
The Netherlands is launching an artificial intelligence efficiency drive to restructure its public sector and reduce annual spending. The government targets the elimination of 25,000 civil servant positions to achieve annual savings of €3.5 billion.

The workforce reductions are part of a broader initiative to modify the administration to be "simpler, smarter, and smaller."
